requirement.description: The _mv method in HttpCli does not properly respond with "201 Created" status for successful move operations. Instead, it returns a generic 200 OK status or an internal server error (500).
requirement.contract: The _mv method should return a response with HTTP status code 201 Created when a move operation succeeds, and the body should be exactly "k\r\n" as expected by the test suite.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_mv.py::TestDedup::test should pass with "201 Created" in response header

requirement.description: The handle_mv method in HttpCli does not properly handle move operations and fails to return a 201 Created status for successful moves.
requirement.contract: The handle_mv method should properly handle the move request and return a 201 Created status with body "k\r\n" upon success.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_mv.py::TestDedup::test should pass with "201 Created" in response header

requirement.description: The _mv method in HttpCli calls the up2k.handle_mv broker method but does not properly handle its response to ensure correct HTTP status codes are returned.
requirement.contract: The _mv method should properly process the response from up2k.handle_mv and ensure the correct HTTP status code (201 Created) is returned for successful moves.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_mv.py::TestDedup::test should pass with "201 Created" in response header

requirement.description: The handle_mv method in Up2k returns a string "k" which is correct, but the HTTP layer doesn't properly convert this to the correct 201 Created response.
requirement.contract: The handle_mv method should return the correct response format that can be properly handled by the HTTP layer to produce a 201 Created response.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_mv.py::TestDedup::test should pass with "201 Created" in response header

requirement.description: The _mv method in HttpCli should properly return a 201 Created status when the move operation succeeds, but currently it's not doing so correctly.
requirement.contract: The _mv method should ensure that upon successful completion of a move operation, it sends back an HTTP 201 Created status with body "k\r\n".
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_mv.py::TestDedup::test should pass with "201 Created" in response header
